sanskrit: tataḥ sa bhagavāṃs tatra aṅgirāḥ samadṛśyata atharvavedamantraiś ca devendraṃ samapūjayat
english: Then the blessed Aṅgiras appeared there and worshipped the lord of the gods with the mantras of the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit: tatas tu bhagavān indraḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ samapadyata varaṃ ca pradadau tasmai atharvāṅgirase tadā
english: Then the blessed Indra was greatly pleased and granted a boon to that Atharvāṅgiras.

sanskrit: atharvāṅgirasaṃ nāma asmin vede bhaviṣyati udāharaṇam etad dhi yajñabhāgaṃ ca lapsyase
english: "In this Veda shall arise the name Atharvāṅgirasa — for this is the illustration — and you shall receive a share of the sacrifice."

sanskrit: evaṃ saṃpūjya bhagavān atharvāṅgirasaṃ tadā vyasarjayan mahārāja devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
english: Having thus honoured Atharvāṅgiras, O great king, the lord of the gods, performer of a hundred sacrifices, then dismissed him.

sanskrit: saṃpūjya sarvāṃs tridaśān ṛṣīṃś cāpi tapodhanān indraḥ pramudito rājan dharmeṇāpālayat prajāḥ
english: Having honoured all the thirty gods and likewise the sages rich in austerity, O king, Indra, greatly rejoiced, protected the people with righteousness.

sanskrit: evaṃ duḥkham anuprāptam indreṇa saha bhāryayā ajñātavāsaś ca kṛtaḥ śatrūṇāṃ vadhakāṅkṣayā
english: In this way Indra too had come to suffer, dwelling incognito together with his wife, desiring the slaying of his enemies.

sanskrit: nātra manyus tvayā kāryo yat kliṣṭo 'si mahāvane draupadyā saha rājendra bhrātṛbhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ
english: You should not harbour anger that you have suffered in the great forest, O lord of kings, together with Draupadī and your noble brothers.

sanskrit: evaṃ tvam api rājendra rājyaṃ prāpsyasi bhārata vṛtraṃ hatvā yathā prāptaḥ śakraḥ kauravanandana
english: Even so shall you too, O lord of kings, O descendant of Bharata, regain your kingdom, just as Śakra gained it after slaying Vṛtra, O joy of the Kurus.

sanskrit: durācāraś ca nahuṣo brahmadviṭ pāpacetanaḥ agastyaśāpābhihato vinaṣṭaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
english: And the wicked Nahuṣa, hater of Brahmins, evil-minded one, was struck by Agastya's curse and perished for endless years.

sanskrit: evaṃ tava durātmānaḥ śatravaḥ śatrusūdana kṣipraṃ nāśaṃ gamiṣyanti karṇaduryodhanādayaḥ
english: Likewise your wicked enemies, O slayer of foes, Karṇa, Duryodhana and the rest, shall swiftly come to ruin.

sanskrit: tataḥ sāgaraparyantāṃ bhokṣyase medinīm imām bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito vīra draupadyā ca sahābhibho
english: Then, O hero, O lord, you shall enjoy this earth bounded by the ocean, together with your brothers and with Draupadī.

sanskrit: upākhyānam idaṃ śakravijayaṃ vedasaṃmitam rājñā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu śrotavyaṃ jayam icchatā
english: This narrative of Śakra's victory, equal in authority to the Veda, should be heard by a king who desires victory when his armies are arrayed for battle.

sanskrit: tasmāt saṃśrāvayāmi tvāṃ vijayaṃ jayatāṃ vara saṃstūyamānā vardhante mahātmāno yudhiṣṭhira
english: Therefore I proclaim to you victory, O best of the victorious — the great souls grow when they are praised, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: kṣatriyāṇām abhāvo 'yaṃ yudhiṣṭhira mahātmanām duryodhanāparādhena bhīmārjunabalena ca
english: This destruction of the great warrior-lords, O Yudhiṣṭhira, shall come through Duryodhana's transgression and through the might of Bhīma and Arjuna.

sanskrit: ākhyānam indravijayaṃ ya idaṃ niyataḥ paṭhet dhūtapāpmā jitasvargaḥ sa pretyeha ca modate
english: Whoever steadfastly recites this tale of Indra's victory shall be cleansed of sin, shall have conquered heaven, and shall rejoice both here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit: na cārijaṃ bhayaṃ tasya na cāputro bhaven naraḥ nāpadaṃ prāpnuyāt kāṃ cid dīrgham āyuś ca vindati sarvatra jayam āpnoti na kadā cit parājayam
english: He shall know no fear born of enemies, nor shall he be without sons; he shall meet with no calamity whatsoever, shall gain long life, shall attain victory everywhere, and shall never suffer defeat.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam āśvāsito rājā śalyena bharatarṣabha pūjayām āsa vidhivac chalyaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus consoled by Śalya, O bull among Bhāratas, the king — foremost of those who uphold righteousness — honoured Śalya according to proper rite.

sanskrit: śrutvā śalyasya vacanaṃ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ pratyuvāca mahābāhur madrarājam idaṃ vacaḥ
english: Having heard Śalya's words, the mighty-armed son of Kuntī, Yudhiṣṭhira, replied to the king of the Madras with these words.

sanskrit: bhavān karṇasya sārathyaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ tatra tejovadhaḥ kāryaḥ karṇasya mama saṃstavaiḥ
english: "You will without doubt act as charioteer to Karṇa. In that role you must diminish Karṇa's spirit through praise of me."

sanskrit: śalya uvāca evam etat kariṣyāmi yathā māṃ saṃprabhāṣase yac cānyad api śakṣyāmi tat kariṣyāmy ahaṃ tava
english: Śalya said: I shall do exactly as you tell me. And whatever else I am able to do for you, that too I shall do.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tata āmantrya kaunteyāñ śalyo madrādhipas tadā jagāma sabalaḥ śrīmān duryodhanam ariṃdamaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then, having taken leave of the sons of Kuntī, Śalya the lord of the Madras, the glorious subduer of foes, departed with his army to Duryodhana.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca yuyudhānas tato vīraḥ sātvatānāṃ mahārathaḥ mahatā caturaṅgeṇa balenāgād yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Yuyudhāna the hero, the great chariot-warrior of the Sātvatas, came to Yudhiṣṭhira with a great four-division army.

sanskrit: tasya yodhā mahāvīryā nānādeśasamāgatāḥ nānāpraharaṇā vīrāḥ śobhayāṃ cakrire balam
english: His warriors of great valour, gathered from many lands, bearing many kinds of weapons — those heroes adorned his army.

sanskrit: paraśvadhair bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ śaktyṛṣṭiparaśuprāsaiḥ karavālaiś ca nirmalaiḥ
english: With battle-axes and slings, with lances, javelins, and clubs, with pikes, spears, axes, and darts, and with gleaming swords —

sanskrit: khaḍgakārmukaniryūhaiḥ śaraiś ca vividhair api tailadhautaiḥ prakāśadbhis tad aśobhata vai balam
english: — with swords, bows, and sheaths, and with arrows of various kinds, oil-polished and gleaming, that army shone resplendently.

sanskrit: tasya meghaprakāśasya śastrais taiḥ śobhitasya ca babhūva rūpaṃ sainyasya meghasyeva savidyutaḥ
english: That army, radiant as a cloud and adorned with those weapons, had the appearance of a storm-cloud blazing with lightning.

sanskrit: akṣauhiṇī hi senā sā tadā yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ balam praviśyāntardadhe rājan sāgaraṃ kunadī yathā
english: For that one akṣauhiṇī force entered the army of Yudhiṣṭhira and disappeared within it, O king, as a small river disappears into the ocean.

sanskrit: tathaivākṣauhiṇīṃ gṛhya cedīnām ṛṣabho balī dhṛṣṭaketur upāgacchat pāṇḍavān amitaujasaḥ
english: Likewise the powerful bull of the Cedis, Dhṛṣṭaketu, took up one akṣauhiṇī and came to the immeasurably valiant Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: māgadhaś ca jayatseno jārāsaṃdhir mahābalaḥ akṣauhiṇyaiva sainyasya dharmarājam upāgamat
english: And Jayatsena the Māgadha, son of Jarāsaṃdha and of great strength, came to the king of righteousness with a single akṣauhiṇī of troops.

sanskrit: tathaiva pāṇḍyo rājendra sāgarānūpavāsibhiḥ vṛto bahuvidhair yodhair yudhiṣṭhiram upāgamat
english: Likewise the Pāṇḍya king, O lord of kings, surrounded by many kinds of warriors dwelling along the seashore, came to Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: tasya sainyam atīvāsīt tasmin balasamāgame prekṣaṇīyataraṃ rājan suveṣaṃ balavat tadā
english: His army at that massing of forces was most splendid to behold, O king — finely adorned and powerful.

sanskrit: drupadasyāpy abhūt senā nānādeśasamāgataiḥ śobhitā puruṣaiḥ śūraiḥ putraiś cāsya mahārathaiḥ
english: Drupada too had an army adorned with valiant men gathered from many lands and with his sons, the great chariot-warriors.

sanskrit: tathaiva rājā matsyānāṃ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ pārvatīyair mahīpālaiḥ sahitaḥ pāṇḍavān iyāt
english: Likewise Virāṭa, king of the Matsyas and lord of his forces, together with mountain-dwelling kings, went to the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: itaś cetaś ca pāṇḍūnāṃ samājagmur mahātmanām akṣauhiṇyas tu saptaiva vividhadhvajasaṃkulāḥ yuyutsamānāḥ kurubhiḥ pāṇḍavān samaharṣayan
english: From here and there the great forces converged upon the noble sons of Pāṇḍu — exactly seven akṣauhiṇīs crowded with varied banners, eager to fight the Kurus, gladdened the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: tathaiva dhārtarāṣṭrasya harṣaṃ samabhivardhayan bhagadatto mahīpālaḥ senām akṣauhiṇīṃ dadau
english: Likewise, augmenting the joy of the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the earth-lord Bhagadatta gave a force of one akṣauhiṇī.

sanskrit: tasya cīnaiḥ kirātaiś ca kāñcanair iva saṃvṛtam babhau balam anādhṛṣyaṃ karṇikāravanaṃ yathā
english: His irresistible army, covered by Chinese and Kirāta warriors as if with gold, shone like a forest of karṇikāra trees.

sanskrit: tathā bhūriśravāḥ śūraḥ śalyaś ca kurunandana duryodhanam upāyātāv akṣauhiṇyā pṛthak pṛthak
english: Likewise the valiant Bhūriśravas and Śalya, O joy of the Kurus, came to Duryodhana each with a separate akṣauhiṇī.

sanskrit: kṛtavarmā ca hārdikyo bhojāndhakabalaiḥ saha akṣauhiṇyaiva senāyā duryodhanam upāgamat
english: And Kṛtavarmā the son of Hṛdika, together with the forces of the Bhojas and Andhakas, came to Duryodhana with a single akṣauhiṇī of troops.

sanskrit: tasya taiḥ puruṣavyāghrair vanamālādharair balam aśobhata yathā mattair vanaṃ prakrīḍitair gajaiḥ
english: His army, adorned by those tiger-like warriors wearing garlands of forest flowers, shone like a forest filled with frolicsome rutting elephants.

sanskrit: jayadrathamukhāś cānye sindhusauvīravāsinaḥ ājagmuḥ pṛthivīpālāḥ kampayanta ivācalān
english: Others headed by Jayadratha, earth-lords dwelling in Sindhu and Sauvīra, came as if shaking the mountains.

sanskrit: teṣām akṣauhiṇī senā bahulā vibabhau tadā vidhūyamānā vātena bahurūpā ivāmbudāḥ
english: The vast akṣauhiṇī army of those kings shone brilliantly then, tossed by the wind, like clouds of many forms.

sanskrit: sudakṣiṇaś ca kāmbojo yavanaiś ca śakais tathā upājagāma kauravyam akṣauhiṇyā viśāṃ pate
english: And Sudakṣiṇa the Kāmboja, together with Yavanas and Śakas, came to the Kaurava chief with one akṣauhiṇī, O lord of peoples.

sanskrit: tasya senāsamāvāyaḥ śalabhānām ivābabhau sa ca saṃprāpya kauravyaṃ tatraivāntardadhe tadā
english: The gathering of his army appeared like a swarm of locusts; and having reached the Kaurava chief, it disappeared within that host.

sanskrit: tathā māhiṣmatīvāsī nīlo nīlāyudhaiḥ saha mahīpālo mahāvīryair dakṣiṇāpathavāsibhiḥ
english: Likewise Nīla, the earth-lord dwelling in Māhiṣmatī, with his dark-weaponed warriors of great valour, inhabitants of the southern road —

sanskrit: āvantyau ca mahīpālau mahābalasusaṃvṛtau pṛthag akṣauhiṇībhyāṃ tāv abhiyātau suyodhanam
english: — and the two earth-lords of the Avantis, well surrounded by great forces, those two came to Suyodhana with separate akṣauhiṇīs.

sanskrit: kekayāś ca naravyāghrāḥ sodaryāḥ pañca pārthivāḥ saṃharṣayantaḥ kauravyam akṣauhiṇyā samādravan
english: And the five Kekaya kings, those tiger-like men and full brothers, gladdening the Kaurava chief, rushed forward with one akṣauhiṇī.

sanskrit: itaś cetaś ca sarveṣāṃ bhūmipānāṃ mahātmanām tisro 'nyāḥ samavartanta vāhinyo bharatarṣabha
english: From here and there, three other armies of all those great earth-lords assembled, O bull among Bhāratas.

sanskrit: evam ekādaśāvṛttāḥ senā duryodhanasya tāḥ yuyutsamānāḥ kaunteyān nānādhvajasamākulāḥ
english: Thus eleven complete armies of Duryodhana, eager to fight the sons of Kuntī, were crowded with varied banners.

sanskrit: na hāstinapure rājann avakāśo 'bhavat tadā rājñāṃ sabalamukhyānāṃ prādhānyenāpi bhārata
english: There was no room at that time in Hāstinapura, O king, even for the foremost leaders of the kings along with their armies, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: tataḥ pañcanadaṃ caiva kṛtsnaṃ ca kurujāṅgalam tathā rohitakāraṇyaṃ marubhūmiś ca kevalā
english: Then the Pañcanada region, the whole of the Kuru forest-land, the Rohitaka wilderness, and the desert tract alone —

sanskrit: ahicchatraṃ kālakūṭaṃ gaṅgākūlaṃ ca bhārata vāraṇā vāṭadhānaṃ ca yāmunaś caiva parvataḥ
english: — Ahicchatra, Kālakūṭa, the Gaṅgā bank, O Bhārata, Vāraṇā, Vāṭadhāna, and the Yamunā mountain —

sanskrit: eṣa deśaḥ suvistīrṇaḥ prabhūtadhanadhānyavān babhūva kauraveyāṇāṃ balena susamākulaḥ
english: — this vast region, rich in wealth and grain, became thoroughly crowded with the armies of the Kaurava host.

sanskrit: tatra sainyaṃ tathāyuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ yaḥ sa pāñcālarājena preṣitaḥ kauravān prati
english: There the priest who had been sent by the king of Pāñcāla to the Kauravas saw that army thus arrayed.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca sa tu kauravyam āsādya drupadasya purohitaḥ satkṛto dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhīṣmeṇa vidureṇa ca
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having reached the Kaurava court, Drupada's priest was duly honoured by Dhṛtarāṣṭra, by Bhīṣma, and by Vidura.

sanskrit: sarvaṃ kauśalyam uktvādau pṛṣṭvā caivam anāmayam sarvasenāpraṇetṝṇāṃ madhye vākyam uvāca ha
english: Having first spoken all the words of courtesy and having enquired about their welfare, he spoke his message in the midst of all the army commanders.

sanskrit: sarvair bhavadbhir vidito rājadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ vākyopādānahetos tu vakṣyāmi vidite sati
english: "The eternal law of kings is known to all of you; yet for the sake of establishing the argument I shall speak even though it is already known.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca pāṇḍuś ca sutāv ekasya viśrutau tayoḥ samānaṃ draviṇaṃ paitṛkaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Pāṇḍu are both renowned sons of the same father; the ancestral wealth belongs equally to both of them — there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya ye putrās te prāptāḥ paitṛkaṃ vasu pāṇḍuputrāḥ kathaṃ nāma na prāptāḥ paitṛkaṃ vasu
english: If the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra have received the paternal wealth, how is it that the sons of Pāṇḍu have not received the paternal wealth?

sanskrit: evaṃ gate pāṇḍaveyair viditaṃ vaḥ purā yathā na prāptaṃ paitṛkaṃ dravyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṇa saṃvṛtam
english: As matters stand, it is known to you from before how the ancestral wealth was withheld and not received, concealed by the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: prāṇāntikair apy upāyaiḥ prayatadbhir anekaśaḥ śeṣavanto na śakitā nayituṃ yamasādanam
english: Though they tried repeatedly with means even that threatened their very lives, those who survived were unable to be led to Yama's abode.

sanskrit: punaś ca vardhitaṃ rājyaṃ svabalena mahātmabhiḥ chadmanāpahṛtaṃ kṣudrair dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ sasaubalaiḥ
english: And the kingdom, which had been enlarged again by their own strength by those great souls, was treacherously seized by the petty sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra together with Śakuni.

sanskrit: tad apy anumataṃ karma tathāyuktam anena vai vāsitāś ca mahāraṇye varṣāṇīha trayodaśa
english: And that deed too was sanctioned and set up by this man — and they were made to dwell in the great forest for thirteen years.

sanskrit: sabhāyāṃ kleśitair vīraiḥ sahabhāryais tathā bhṛśam araṇye vividhāḥ kleśāḥ saṃprāptās taiḥ sudāruṇāḥ
english: After those heroes were tormented together with their wife in the assembly hall, very grievous and varied hardships were then suffered by them in the forest.

sanskrit: tathā virāṭanagare yonyantaragatair iva prāptaḥ paramasaṃkleśo yathā pāpair mahātmabhiḥ
english: Likewise in the city of Virāṭa, as though they had entered a different womb, extreme suffering was endured by those noble ones — as if by sinners.

sanskrit: te sarve pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tat sarvaṃ pūrvakilbiṣam sāmaiva kurubhiḥ sārdham icchanti kurupuṃgavāḥ
english: Yet those bulls among the Kurus, having put all those earlier offences behind them, desire nothing but peace together with the Kurus.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ ca vṛttam ājñāya vṛttaṃ duryodhanasya ca anunetum ihārhanti dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ suhṛjjanāḥ
english: Knowing both the conduct of these men and the conduct of Duryodhana, well-wishers here ought to bring Dhṛtarāṣṭra around.

sanskrit: na hi te vigrahaṃ vīrāḥ kurvanti kurubhiḥ saha avināśena lokasya kāṅkṣante pāṇḍavāḥ svakam
english: For those heroes, the Pāṇḍavas, do not enter into conflict with the Kurus — they desire what is their own without the destruction of the world.

sanskrit: yaś cāpi dhārtarāṣṭrasya hetuḥ syād vigrahaṃ prati sa ca hetur na mantavyo balīyāṃsas tathā hi te
english: And whatever reason the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra may have for conflict — that reason should not be heeded, for the Pāṇḍavas are the stronger side.

sanskrit: akṣauhiṇyo hi saptaiva dharmaputrasya saṃgatāḥ yuyutsamānāḥ kurubhiḥ pratīkṣante 'sya śāsanam
english: For seven akṣauhiṇīs have gathered under the son of Dharma, eager to fight the Kurus, and await his command.

sanskrit: apare puruṣavyāghrāḥ sahasrākṣauhiṇīsamāḥ sātyakir bhīmasenaś ca yamau ca sumahābalau
english: Other tiger-like men equal to a thousand akṣauhiṇīs — Sātyaki, Bhīmasena, and the twin brothers of immense power —

sanskrit: ekādaśaitāḥ pṛtanā ekataś ca samāgatāḥ ekataś ca mahābāhur bahurūpo dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: — these eleven armies have assembled on one side, and on the other side stands the mighty-armed Dhanaṃjaya, he of many forms.

sanskrit: yathā kirīṭī senābhyaḥ sarvābhyo vyatiricyate evam eva mahābāhur vāsudevo mahādyutiḥ
english: As Arjuna the diademed surpasses all armies, so too does the mighty-armed Vāsudeva of great splendour.

sanskrit: bahulatvaṃ ca senānāṃ vikramaṃ ca kirīṭinaḥ buddhimattāṃ ca kṛṣṇasya buddhvā yudhyeta ko naraḥ
english: Knowing the vastness of the armies, the valour of the diademed one, and the wisdom of Kṛṣṇa — what man would choose to fight?

sanskrit: te bhavanto yathādharmaṃ yathāsamayam eva ca prayacchantu pradātavyaṃ mā vaḥ kālo 'tyagād ayam
english: Let your honours give what ought to be given, in accordance with righteousness and in accordance with the agreement — let not this moment pass you by."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā prajñāvṛddho mahādyutiḥ saṃpūjyainaṃ yathākālaṃ bhīṣmo vacanam abravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having heard his words, the one great in wisdom and of great splendour — Bhīṣma — having duly honoured him at the fitting moment, then spoke.

sanskrit: diṣṭyā kuśalinaḥ sarve pāṇḍavāḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ diṣṭyā sahāyavantaś ca diṣṭyā dharme ca te ratāḥ
english: "By good fortune all the Pāṇḍavas are well together with their kinsmen; by good fortune they have allies; by good fortune they are devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit: diṣṭyā ca saṃdhikāmās te bhrātaraḥ kurunandanāḥ diṣṭyā na yuddhamanasaḥ saha dāmodareṇa te
english: By good fortune those brothers, the joy of the Kurus, desire peace; by good fortune they are not minded for war, together with Dāmodara.

sanskrit: bhavatā satyam uktaṃ ca sarvam etan na saṃśayaḥ atitīkṣṇaṃ tu te vākyaṃ brāhmaṇyād iti me matiḥ
english: All that you have said is true — there is no doubt. Yet your speech is overly sharp, I think, on account of your Brahmin nature.

sanskrit: asaṃśayaṃ kleśitās te vane ceha ca pāṇḍavāḥ prāptāś ca dharmataḥ sarvaṃ pitur dhanam asaṃśayam
english: Without doubt those Pāṇḍavas were made to suffer, in the forest and here; and without doubt they have rightfully earned all their father's wealth.

sanskrit: kirīṭī balavān pārthaḥ kṛtāstraś ca mahābalaḥ ko hi pāṇḍusutaṃ yuddhe viṣaheta dhanaṃjayam
english: Arjuna the diademed son of Pāṇḍu is strong, skilled in weapons, and of great might — who indeed could withstand Dhanaṃjaya in battle?"
